in_marathi.name: Rekshitha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Seeker of peace
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rekshitha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who seeks peace and tranquility in life. Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Rekha' meaning line or border, and 'Shitha' meaning calm or tranquil.

in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Seeker of peace
